indicators.label: Registered temples and churches (寺廟教會堂數)
indicators.description: Count of registered religious places (temples 寺廟 plus churches 教會堂) in the county/city, from MOI statis table 06-01. An administrative register count, not an OSM site snapshot, and not census affiliation.
indicators.method: Published MOI table 06-01 total (合計) for the county/city and reference year-end.
indicators.spatial_coverage: 22 county/city units; provincial subtotals (臺灣省, 福建省) used only for national reconciliation.
indicators.quality_notes: For every year the 22 county totals sum exactly to the MOI published national total.

indicators.label: Registered temple followers (信徒人數)
indicators.description: Legacy area-summary field carrying the MOI reported registered temple followers. It does not measure census religious affiliation, belief, or attendance.
indicators.method: Published MOI table 06-01 follower count (信徒人數) for the county/city and reference year-end.
indicators.quality_notes: 信徒人數在102年以前含寺廟信徒人數與教(會)堂教徒人數，自103年起僅包括寺廟信徒人數. Church members are not in this column across the shipped years.

indicators.label: Registered places per 10,000 residents
indicators.description: Registered temples and churches per 10,000 year-end household-registration residents.
indicators.method: place_count divided by MOI year-end population (table 02-01), times 10,000.
indicators.quality_notes: Denominator is MOI household-registration population, not a census enumeration.
